prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A close-up, cinematic shot of a man’s face, centered in the frame, illuminated by the cool blue and orange glow of futuristic holographic displays. The man has a neatly groomed goatee and mustache, with expressive brown eyes focused intently forward, conveying concentration and determination. His skin is softly lit, with subtle reflections of the holographic interface dancing across his features, enhancing the sense of immersion in advanced technology. Surrounding his face, semi-transparent digital graphics and icons float in three-dimensional space, including circular data readouts, technical schematics, and text labels, all rendered in a sleek, high-tech style. The background is dark and indistinct, drawing all attention to the subject and the vibrant, interactive HUD elements. The overall color palette is dominated by deep blacks, electric blues, and vivid oranges, creating a dramatic, high-contrast look. The composition uses a shallow depth of field, keeping the man’s face sharply in focus while the holographic elements appear slightly blurred at the edges, emphasizing the immersive, first-person perspective. The style is reminiscent of a sci-fi blockbuster, with a polished, cinematic quality and a sense of urgency and innovation.
